{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma2oa

|version2= 1.00

|gr1= Containers

|descr= Returns all backpack types and count from the cargo space.

|s1= [[getBackpackCargo]] object

|p1= object: [[Object]] - object to check

|r1= [[Array]] with [classes, counts]
* classes: [[Array]] of [[String]]s - Backpack class names
* counts: [[Array]] of [[Number]]s - Backpack counts

|x1= <sqf>
getBackpackCargo cursorTarget;
/*
	returns e.g
	[
        ["5BackpackA", "10BackpackB"]
        [5, 10]
	]
*/
</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_content = getBackpackCargo carName;</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>_content = getBackpackCargo ammoBoxName;</sqf>
